modules.title: Introduction to Owe II and Idioms
modules.html:
Advanced Yoruba proverbs and idioms and their uses. This section covers introduction to owe ii and idioms.

Key points

  • Owe: 'Agùntàn tó bá bá ajá rìn, yóò jẹ _____'. — Ìgbẹ́.

Worked examples

Q: Owe: 'Agùntàn tó bá bá ajá rìn, yóò jẹ _____'.
A: Ìgbẹ́ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ìgbẹ́.

Q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe kọ́nṣónáǹtì nínú èdè Yorùbá?
A: c — The letter 'c' does not exist in the Yoruba alphabet; its sound is usually represented by 's' or 'ṣ'.

More key points

  • Owe: 'Agùntàn tó bá bá ajá rìn, yóò jẹ _____'. — Ìgbẹ́.

quiz.q: Owe: 'Agùntàn tó bá bá ajá rìn, yóò jẹ _____'.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ìgbẹ́.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe kọ́nṣónáǹtì nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: The letter 'c' does not exist in the Yoruba alphabet; its sound is usually represented by 's' or 'ṣ'.

quiz.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́-oògùn 'Èmi' nínú gírámà?
quiz.solution: 'Èmi' is the first-person singular (ẹni kìn-ín-ní ẹyọ) pronoun.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe ọ̀nà ìpè kọ́nṣónáǹtì?
quiz.solution: 'gb' is a consonant itself, not a place or manner of articulation.

quiz.q: Èwo ni 'Labio-dental fricative' kọ́nṣónáǹtì?
quiz.solution: The consonant 'f' is a labio-dental fricative.

quiz.q: Èwo ni fáwẹ́lì iwájú, fífẹ̀ (open front)?
quiz.solution: 'a' is an open front vowel in Yoruba.

quiz.q: Ta ni ó kọ ìwé 'Ó le kú'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Kọ́lá Akínlàdé.

quiz.q: Èṣù jẹ́ òrìṣà:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Oníwàhálà/Ẹlẹ́gbára.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Pronoun'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀ Arọ́pò Orúkọ.

quiz.q: Ààrẹ Ọ̀nà Kakanfò jẹ́:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Balógun ogun.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Book'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ìwé.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Sit'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Jókòó.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Oríkì'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Praise Poetry.

quiz.q: Ọ̀rọ̀ wo ló ní sílébù mẹ́ta?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Aláàfin.

quiz.q: Kí ni orúkọ ìlú tí Odùduwà sọ̀kalẹ̀ sí?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ilé-Ifẹ̀.

quiz.q: Ta ni òrìṣà irin?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ògún.

quiz.q: Ipo wo ni 'Iya' wà nínú ẹbi Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Olùtọ́jú àti Olùfẹ́.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni fawẹ́lì àránmú?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: an.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe ọ̀nà ìgbéyàwó nílẹ̀ Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Sátáńtì.

quiz.q: Àlọ́ tí a máa ń pa ní alẹ́ jẹ́ ọ̀nà...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ìdánidárayá.

quiz.q: Kí ni orúkọ oúnjẹ tí a fi iṣu ṣe?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Iyán.

quiz.q: Ògún jẹ́ òrìṣà fún:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Irin.

quiz.q: Iṣẹ́ wo ni bàtá lílù jẹ́?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Àyàn.

quiz.q: Èwo ni ẹranko ilé?

quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Méjìdínlógún (18).
